title: Calm Agent: Reframing Agent Interaction around Intermittent Human Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.32009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents can carry out auxiliary tasks while users focus on other work. Yet users still need to understand task state, make changes, and respond when help is required. We argue that agents for ongoing auxiliary tasks should be designed around intermittent human attention: tasks should continue between interactions, and users should be able to return with little effort to understand and control them. We develop this position as Calm Agent. It connects three on-demand interaction modes: Delegate, Adjust, and Check, through a persistent task representation. Generative interaction provides controls and feedback suited to open-ended goals, while existing controls support routine actions. We illustrate these principles with Orvlet, a desktop prototype for background execution and compact task interfaces. translated_title: 平静智能体：围绕人类间歇性注意力重构智能体交互
translated_abstract: AI智能体可以在用户专注于其他工作时执行辅助任务。然而，用户仍然需要了解任务状态、进行修改，并在需要帮助时作出响应。我们主张，面向持续性辅助任务的智能体应当围绕人类间歇性的注意力来设计：任务应在交互间隙持续运行，用户应能够以很小的代价随时返回并理解与控制这些任务。我们将这一立场发展为“平静智能体”。它通过一种持久化的任务表示，连接了三种按需交互模式：委托、调整和查看。生成式交互为开放性目标提供合适的控制与反馈，而现有控件则支持常规操作。我们以Orvlet来阐述这些原则，这是一个支持后台执行与紧凑任务界面的桌面原型。我们识别了若干挑战，包括在保持连续性的同时调整界面、跨任务协调注意力，以及提供及时的响应交互。
tldr: 本文提出“平静智能体”设计理念，主张围绕用户间歇性注意力设计辅助型AI智能体，通过持久任务表示连接“委托、调整、查看”三种按需交互模式，使任务在交互间隙持续运行且用户可低成本返回理解与控制，并以桌面原型Orvlet加以演示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Calm Agent," a design approach that reframes AI agent interaction around users' intermittent attention, connecting Delegate, Adjust, and Check modes through a persistent task representation so that tasks continue between interactions and users can effortlessly return to understand and control them, illustrated by the desktop prototype Orvlet.
